# move gopath to HOME/go

Stop overriding `GOPATH`: since Go 1.8 it defaults to `$HOME/go`, so the custom location the dotfiles exported (the toolset build targeted `$(go env GOPATH)/bin`, and the author's checkouts lived under `~/Development/go`, as the paths in [[DOT-83]] show) was one more thing to configure and one more thing that differed between machines.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/105#issuecomment-5711678958
Note: `env.bash` exports the custom `PATH` only when `$SHLVL -eq 1`; shells started at level 2 (some terminal apps, `tmux`, nested shells) inherit whatever the parent had, so `~/go/bin` may be missing there. Intended, but worth knowing when a tool is "not found" in a subshell.
-->
